package fixture

import (
	"testing"

	qt "github.com/frankban/quicktest"
)

func TestViolations(t *testing.T) {
	qt.Assert(t, 1, qt.Equals, 1)
	qt.Check(
		t,
		2,
		qt.Equals,
		2,
	)
	qt .Assert(t, 3, qt.Equals, 3)

	c := qt.New(t)
	c.Run("receiver named c", func(c *qt.C) {
		c.Assert(4, qt.Equals, 4)
	})

	outer := qt.New(t)
	outer.Run("neither identifier is c", func(inner *qt.C) {
		inner.Assert(5, qt.Equals, 5)
	})
	qt.New(t).Run("receiver is not an identifier at all", func(c *qt.C) {
		c.Assert(6, qt.Equals, 6)
	})
}
